Sapling (Kallidus) pricing in 2026

Sapling sits within Kallidus, and Kallidus publishes no price for it: the site routes to a quote. Sapling is an onboarding- and offboarding-led HR platform, and payroll stays with a separate provider connected by integration, so the cost to compare is the Sapling quote plus your payroll provider. Get the Sapling rate, any add-on modules and implementation in writing and set the total against the published HRIS rates ($3 to $29 per employee per month) in the ledger.

How the price is built

Onboarding and offboarding workflow is the core; payroll stays with a separate provider through an integration.

What to get priced in writing

  • The per-employee rate for each module you take, as separate lines
  • Any monthly base or platform fee, stated separately from the per-employee rate
  • Whether any charge is per payroll run rather than per month, and the rate
  • The one-time implementation fee and what it covers
  • The contract term, any seat minimum, and the annual renewal increase cap in writing

For scale, the vendors that do publish an HRIS seat rate list from $3 to $29 per employee per month (every published rate). Enter your Sapling (Kallidus) quote under “Your quote” in the ledger to set it against them over 3 years.

Where does Sapling sit now?

Within Kallidus, which sells it alongside its learning and recruiting products.

Does Kallidus publish a price for Sapling?

No. There is no published per-employee rate or implementation fee; pricing is by quote.

Does Sapling run payroll?

No. Payroll stays with a separate provider connected through an integration, so price that provider too when comparing Sapling with an all-in-one HRIS.

What should a Sapling quote show?

The per-employee rate, which workflows and modules are included and which are add-ons, the implementation fee, the term and the renewal cap.
